name: Hanagusuku Atori
source:
Position of the mark: On her left arm
Curse: [spoiler]Forbidden to ask for help[/spoiler]
Gift: [spoiler]Mental acceleration, the ability which makes events to proceed slow from own perspective[/spoiler]

Proud of her deceased grandfather, proud of her bloodline, proud of her wealth, proud to be half-Russian, proud to be independent, proud to be a pretty girl, proud to love girls, proud to be a lesbian, proud of her "techniques", and proud to be... perverted. As conceited as she can be, she does not admit that the thing she has is a curse but a sign of being "the chosen one". She never fails to pull off her lesbian antics whenever there is a chance. She goes all-out unleashing her "paradise finger" to all the girls except for [url=/c1789]Tomo[/url], her favorite, and [url=/c1790]Rui[/url], her nemesis.
